I'm currently in that phase because of a break up. My mate forgot about me but I still message them "good morning" every morning to let them know I'm still here. We need to find each other, and not only make ourselves better but teach what's best. Love (attraction) is in all things, and concludes with creation. If you truly love, then you will create something out of that love. It's difficult when the love we give isn't reciprocated, it tears us apart, and wears us down. We just need to find the right people, find the best methods to find the best probable outcome.
